title: rhaphiolepis williamtelliana
intro: Rhaphiolepis williamtelliana, commonly known as the White Pearl or William's Hibiscus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae, native to China. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rhaphiolepis williamtelliana are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been isolated from the plant's leaves, flowers, and stems.
